title: Brewery Cooling Water Upgrade
body:
The brewery's glycol and cooling-water pumps were oversized and ran on throttled valves. We replaced them with two IP-80 inline pumps on variable speed drives.

Result: 41% lower pump energy in the first quarter and quieter cellar.

title: Municipal Valve Replacement Program
body: A three-year program to replace 140 seized gate valves across the distribution network. We supplied GV-100 and BF-150 valves in batches matched to the utility's dig schedule.

title: Compressed Air Audit for a Furniture Plant
body: Leak survey, demand logging and a right-sized system: one VS-22 replaced two old piston compressors. Payback was 14 months.

title: Asphalt Plant Bitumen Pumps
body: Two GT-350 °C jacketed gear pumps for bitumen transfer, with heat tracing on the suction lines. No cold-start failures since installation.

title: Dairy Clean-in-Place Pump Skid
body: A skid with LP-10 lobe pumps and a return pump for the cleaning circuit, built and pressure-tested in our workshop.

title: Water Treatment Dosing Retrofit
body: Eight DZ-1 dosing pumps replaced mechanical diaphragm units. Chemical use dropped 12% thanks to flow-paced dosing.

title: Mine Dewatering Rental Fleet
body: Twelve SP-50 self-priming pumps on trailers, with a service contract and a 24-hour spare swap.
